summary: The Hammer of Brell is the divine chamber where Brell Serilis shapes creation itself. Every strike of the hammer echoes through Underfoot, forming stone guardians, crystal titans, and the foundations of worlds.
history: The Hammer of Brell was forged from the first stone of Underfoot.
Its strikes shaped the earliest divine constructs.
The chamber was sealed until the Age of Turmoil.
The Hammer itself became a living entity of divine craftsmanship.
